job.description: The distributed job this run is an instance of.

jobSpecs.description: The array of configurations this job run must execute.

mlOperationRun.description:
When {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.Job#start} is invoked, it returns an {@link MlOperationRun}.
That is referenced in this field so that it may be used to fetch the job run for downstream
debugging, inspection, or monitoring.

options.description: Options that were used to specify execution constraints for this training job run.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
Manages the execution of a set of post model training jobs run for each {@link ReliabilityAsset} - {@ReliabilityMlModel} combination.
This is created by {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob#start}.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJobRun
